fields.value: Approximately regular ventricular spacing over this short strip, with a conditional mean rate near 79 bpm and separate P-like lobes in the reviewed interior cycles. Sinus origin requires confirmation of uniform sinus P waves and a consistent 1:1 P-QRS relationship throughout. The deep negative QRS component alone is not diagnostic, and normal conduction remains unestablished.

limitations: New wave-field estimates remain provisional and unscored. Range width reflects uncertain endpoints and reader disagreement, not a validated diagnostic category. QT/QTc, calibrated amplitudes and clinical diagnosis are not established.
